# Repository instructions — Engineering Governance

Read `AGENTS.md` and `GLOBAL-ENGINEERING-RULES.md` before any diagnosis, edit, PR, merge or release.

This repository is the canonical global policy source. Keep generic rules here; project-specific rules belong in each project's overlay. Never weaken fail-closed deploy, parallel-work merge lock, production-data protection or least-privilege safeguards without an explicit Gonza instruction.
